comments.body: Grep across monorepo shows zero remaining usages outside the token file itself — safe to delete.

content.text: Grep across monorepo shows zero remaining usages outside the token file itself — safe to delete.

Filter chip color tokens --chip-filter-bg-legacy and --chip-filter-fg-muted-v1 still ship in the design-system CSS bundle even though no product surface imports them after the 2025 palette refresh. They inflate the token dump and confuse designers scanning the Figma-to-code map.

Delete the deprecated token definitions, remove them from the theme export map, and bump the design-system minor so consumers that still reference them get a clear compile break rather than silent fallbacks.
